title: Fun with Symmetry: Lines of Symmetry
seo_title: Lines of Symmetry Class 4 Worksheet with Answers (Maths Mela Chapter 11)
standard_code: Class 4, Maths Mela Chapter 11: Fun with Symmetry
standard_text: Symmetry: identifying lines of symmetry in shapes, letters and designs, and completing symmetric figures (summary of NCERT Maths Mela Class 4)
meta_desc: Class 4 Fun with Symmetry worksheet (Maths Mela Chapter 11): lines of symmetry, letters, completing shapes and symmetry around us. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: A line of symmetry makes two mirror halves.
key_sub: Fold along the line: the halves match.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A shape is symmetric if one half is the mirror image of the other.
  • A square has 4 lines of symmetry; a rectangle has 2; a circle has many.

Examples

Example

How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?

Fold it across and down

Answer: 2

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting the diagonals of a rectangleFold along a diagonal: the halves do not match.
Shifting instead of reflectingEach point must be the same distance from the mirror line.

faq.q: What is a line of symmetry?
faq.a: A line that divides a shape into two halves that are mirror images.
No. A scalene triangle has no line of symmetry.

sets.title: Is it a line of symmetry?

items.q: Imagine folding the rectangle along the dashed line. Is the dashed line a line of symmetry?
c: Yes, the parts are the same size
No, same size but not matching
items.e: Fold along the dashed line: one half lands exactly on top of the other, so it is a mirror line.

items.q: Imagine folding the square along the dashed line. Is the dashed line a line of symmetry?
c: No, same size but not matching
Yes, the parts are the same size
items.e: The dashed line is not through the middle, so one part is bigger. The smaller part cannot cover the bigger part when you fold, so it is not a mirror line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
items.e: A square has 4 mirror lines: one up and down, one across and 2 along the diagonals, from corner to corner. Students often forget the diagonals.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
items.e: A rectangle has 2 mirror lines: up and down, and across, through the middles of the sides. A diagonal splits it into 2 equal triangles, but they do not fit when folded, so the diagonals do not count.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle (3 equal sides) have?
items.e: Each mirror line goes from a corner to the middle of the side opposite. 3 corners, so 3 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does an isosceles triangle (2 equal sides) have?
items.e: Only the line from the top corner to the middle of the bottom side works: 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a scalene triangle (no equal sides) have?
items.e: The 3 sides are all different lengths, so no fold makes the halves fit. 0 lines of symmetry.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
items.e: Any straight line through the centre of a circle is a mirror line. You could never draw them all, so a circle has infinitely many.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rhombus have?
items.e: This rhombus (not a square) has 2 mirror lines, both from corner to corner. Lines through the middles of the sides do not work.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a parallelogram have?
items.e: A parallelogram with slanting sides has 0 mirror lines. Its diagonals and its middle lines split it into equal halves, but none of them fit when folded.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a kite have?
items.e: Only the line from the top corner to the bottom corner works, so a kite has 1 mirror line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does an isosceles trapezium have?
items.e: Only the up-and-down line through the middles of the top and bottom works. Folding across does not, because the top is shorter than the bottom: 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular pentagon have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. Each line goes from a corner to the middle of the side opposite. 5 sides, so 5 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. 3 lines join opposite corners and 3 more join the middles of opposite sides: 3 + 3 = 6 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular octagon have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. 4 lines join opposite corners and 4 join the middles of opposite sides: 4 + 4 = 8 lines.
Only the line straight up through the middle of the flat side works: 1 line. Folding across puts the curve on the flat side.
An oval has 2 lines of symmetry: one across the long way and one up and down. Slanting lines do not work, because it is not a circle.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this cross (all 4 arms the same) have?
items.e: Up and down and across both work, and so do the 2 slanting lines through the inside corners: 4 lines, just like a square.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 3 lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (equilateral triangle) 3 lines, B (square) 4 lines, C (isosceles triangle) 1 line, D (rectangle) 2 lines. So the answer is A.

items.q: Which shape has no lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (rhombus) 2 lines, B (rectangle) 2 lines, C (kite) 1 line, D (parallelogram) 0 lines. So the answer is D.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 1 line of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (parallelogram) 0 lines, B (rhombus) 2 lines, C (kite) 1 line, D (rectangle) 2 lines. So the answer is C.

items.q: Which shape has the most lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (square) 4 lines, B (regular octagon) 8 lines, C (regular pentagon) 5 lines, D (regular hexagon) 6 lines. So the answer is B.

items.q: The dashed line is a mirror line. The left half is the same in all 4 pictures. In which picture is the shape completed correctly?
items.e: Each shaded square needs a partner in the same row, the same number of squares from the mirror line on the other side. Only B is a true mirror image. Others: A: the half was turned upside down, not flipped; C: the half was slid across, not flipped (squares counted from the wrong edge); D: one square is missing.

items.q: The mirror line runs through the middle of a column. Shade squares to the right of the line to make the picture symmetrical. How many squares will be shaded altogether?
items.e: 10 squares are shaded now. 4 of them sit on the mirror line, so each is its own partner: count them once. The other 6 each need a partner. 6 + 6 + 4 = 16.

items.q: The mirror line runs through the middle of a row. Shade squares below the line to make the picture symmetrical. How many squares will be shaded altogether?
items.e: 12 squares are shaded now. 5 of them sit on the mirror line, so each is its own partner: count them once. The other 7 each need a partner. 7 + 7 + 5 = 19.

items.q: The mirror line runs through the middle of a column. How many more squares must be shaded to make the picture symmetrical?
items.e: Squares on the mirror line are their own partners. 10 squares are shaded and 4 sit on the line, so 10 − 4 = 6 more squares.

items.q: The mirror line runs through the middle of a row. How many more squares must be shaded to make the picture symmetrical?
items.e: Squares on the mirror line are their own partners. 13 squares are shaded and 6 sit on the line, so 13 − 6 = 7 more squares.

Only C is a true mirror image. Others: A: it was flipped as if the mirror line went straight up and down; B: one square is in the wrong place; D: the half was turned upside down, not flipped.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter A have?
items.e: Fold A straight down the middle and the 2 slanting sides match: a vertical line. Folded across, the point would land on the open bottom, so there is no horizontal line.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter D have?
items.e: Fold D across the middle: the top half of the curve lands on the bottom half. That is a horizontal line. Folded up and down, the straight side would land on the curve.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter H have?
items.e: H has both: fold it up and down and the 2 posts match; fold it across and the top lands on the bottom. Do not stop after finding the vertical line.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter F have?
items.e: F has no line of symmetry. Folded up and down, the arms point the wrong way; folded across, the top arm has no partner at the bottom.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter T have?
items.e: Fold T straight down the middle and the 2 sides of the top bar match: a vertical line only.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter X have?
items.e: X has both a vertical and a horizontal line. It is taller than it is wide, so the slanting lines do not work.

items.q: This is the digit 8 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold the 8 up and down: the sides match. Fold it across: the top box lands on the bottom box. 2 lines. It is taller than it is wide, so the corner-to-corner lines do not work.

items.q: This is the digit 3 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Folded up and down, the 3 is open on the left, so that does not work. Folded across, the top half lands on the bottom half: 1 line, and it is horizontal. Do not look only for vertical lines.

items.q: This is the digit 0 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: This 0 is a tall rectangle: one vertical and one horizontal line, so 2. It is not a circle, so it does not have infinitely many, and its diagonals do not work.

items.q: This is the digit 5 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold the 5 up and down or across: the parts never land on each other. 0 lines. A 5 looks the same upside down, but that is a turn, not a fold.

items.q: Which capital letter has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: Fold E across the middle and the top arm lands on the bottom arm. M, T and V have a vertical line instead.

items.q: Which capital letter has no line of symmetry?
items.e: R has no line of symmetry: the leg at the bottom right has no partner. H has 2, A has a vertical one and C has a horizontal one.

items.q: Which capital letter has 2 lines of symmetry?
items.e: O matches when folded up and down and when folded across. A and W have only a vertical line, and E only a horizontal one. Remember to check across as well as up and down.
Fold Y straight down the middle and the 2 arms match. B, D and C have a horizontal line, not a vertical one.

items.q: These are digits on a digital clock. Which digit has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: Fold the 3 across the middle: the top half lands on the bottom half. 2, 4 and 7 have no line of symmetry.

items.q: These are digits on a digital clock. Which digit has no line of symmetry?
items.e: 7 has no line of symmetry. 0 and 8 have 2 lines each. 3 has a horizontal line: do not forget to fold across.

items.q: Meera writes 4 words in capital letters. Which word has a horizontal line of symmetry through the whole word?
items.e: C, O, D and E each have a horizontal line of symmetry, so a fold across the middle of CODE works. TOY, MOON and BOAT each have a letter that does not (T, Y, M, N, A).

items.q: Arjun writes 4 words in capital letters. Which word has a vertical line of symmetry down the middle?
items.e: W and O each have a vertical line, and WOW reads the same from both ends, so a fold down the middle of the O works. BOB and DAD read the same both ways, but B and D only have a horizontal line. N has no line at all.

items.q: On a digital display, which number has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: Both digits must fold onto themselves across the middle. 3 and 8 both do, so 38 does. 85 does not: the 5 has no line of symmetry.

items.q: Zoya sees 88 on a digital display. How many lines of symmetry does the whole number have?
items.e: One horizontal line goes across both digits, and one vertical line goes down the gap between them. That is 2 lines for the whole number, not 2 for each digit.
Only the line straight down the body works: each wing lands on the wing opposite. Folded across, the big top wings would land on the small bottom wings. 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this leaf have?
items.e: Fold along the middle vein: the veins on each side match. Folded across, the stalk has nothing to match, so there is just 1 line.

items.q: This flag has a cross through the middle, like the flag of England. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold it up and down or across: the cross lands on itself both times. The diagonals do not work, because the flag is a rectangle, not a square. 2 lines.

items.q: This flag has a cross from corner to corner, like the flag of Scotland. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: The cross runs along the diagonals, but the diagonals of a rectangle are not mirror lines. Folding up and down or across does match the 2 bands: 2 lines.

items.q: This flag has a white top half and a green bottom half. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Folding across puts white on green, so it does not work: colours must match too. Folding up and down matches white with white and green with green: 1 line.

items.q: On this flag the cross is to the left of the middle. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Folding up and down does not work, because the upright bar is not in the middle. Folding across does: 1 line.

items.q: A road sign has this shape, with no writing on it. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: It is a regular octagon: 4 lines join opposite corners and 4 join the middles of opposite sides. 8 lines. (With the word STOP on it, it would have none.)

items.q: This warning sign has no picture inside yet. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: It is an equilateral triangle. Each mirror line goes from a corner to the middle of the side opposite: 3 lines.

items.q: This road sign is a red circle with a white bar across it. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: A plain circle has infinitely many, but the bar spoils most of them. Only the line across and the line up and down keep the bar on itself: 2 lines.

items.q: This blue road sign has a white arrow pointing up. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Only the line straight up through the arrow works. Folding across would put the arrow’s point on its tail: 1 line.

items.q: This snowflake has 6 arms that are all the same. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: 3 lines go along pairs of opposite arms, and 3 more go between the arms. 3 + 3 = 6 lines, one for each arm.

items.q: A stop sign has this shape. Without the word STOP, how many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: It is a regular octagon: 4 lines join opposite corners and 4 join the middles of opposite sides. 8 lines. (With the word on it, it would have none.)

items.q: A yield sign is a triangle pointing down like this. Without any words, how many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: It is an equilateral triangle, just upside down. Each line of symmetry goes from a corner to the middle of the side opposite: 3 lines.

items.q: This is a hockey rink seen from above. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold it along the red centre line: each end matches. Fold it across the long way: the top lands on the bottom. 2 lines. The corner-to-corner lines do not work, because the rink is not a square.

items.q: This is a canoe seen from above. Both ends are the same. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold it across the middle: one end lands on the other. Fold it the long way: one side lands on the other. 2 lines, like an oval.

items.q: Priya has a square sheet of origami paper. In how many different ways can she fold it in half so that the two halves match exactly?
items.e: A square has 4 lines of symmetry: up and down, across, and the 2 diagonals. So there are 4 ways.

items.q: Aditya folds a beach towel, 2 m long and 1 m wide, from one corner to the opposite corner. Do the two halves match?
items.e: The diagonal splits the towel into 2 equal triangles, but they do not fit on top of each other, because the towel is not a square. A rectangle has only 2 lines of symmetry.

items.q: A Class 4 makes a plain rectangular banner for the Charity Run. Arjun says it has 4 lines of symmetry. How many does it really have?
items.e: A rectangle that is not a square has 2 lines: up and down, and across. Arjun counted the diagonals, but they do not work.

items.q: Simran traces a hexagon pattern block. It is a regular hexagon. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. 6 sides, so 6 lines: 3 through opposite corners and 3 through the middles of opposite sides.

items.q: Sneha draws a triangle with 3 equal sides. She finds the up-and-down line of symmetry and stops. How many lines does it have?
items.e: A triangle with 3 equal sides is regular, so it has 3 lines of symmetry, one from each corner to the middle of the opposite side. Look for slanting lines, not only vertical ones.
